title: File download does not check the caller's tenant
exploit_scenario: Sign in as any user of tenant B, then GET /files/<id of a tenant A file>/download with the fd_session cookie; the handler loads the file by id alone and returns tenant A's bytes. File ids appear in share URLs and in support tickets.
recommendation: In download, return 404 unless f.TenantID equals auth.From(ctx).TenantID, as preview already does at line 64.

title: Share links never expire
exploit_scenario: Create a share link with POST /files/<id>/share, wait any length of time, GET /s/<token>: the file is still served. CreatedAt is stored but Resolve never compares it with the current time.
recommendation: Reject tokens older than the documented 7 days in Resolve and delete them.

title: Antivirus API key committed in a ConfigMap
exploit_scenario: Anyone with read access to the repository or to ConfigMaps in the filedrop namespace reads AVSCAN_API_KEY=avscan-FAKE-0000-EXAMPLE-KEY-NOT-REAL and can call the scanning vendor as filedrop.
recommendation: Rotate the key, move it to a Kubernetes Secret and reference it with secretKeyRef.
